description: List the live projects in a workspace, most recently opened first. Call this after list_workspaces and match a target URL or product name against these before creating anything new.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_projects

color.description: Hex colour shown for the project in the dashboard.

id.description: Project UUID, the project_id other tools take.

product_description.description: What the product does, used as context for actors and interviews.

project_type.description: What kind of product this is, e.g. website or figma_prototype.

url.description: Primary URL of the product, when one is set.

title: List projects
